[[File:Shepherd.png|thumb|right|250px|Shepherd]] '''Shepherd''' (Japanese: '''スギウラ''' ''Sugiura'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. He first appeared in ''[[BW090|Jostling for the Junior Cup!]]'', where he participated in the [[Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup]] and was {{an|Cilan}}'s first opponent. However, he was defeated by him and eliminated from the tournament. He made a cameo appearance in ''[[BW093|Goodbye, Junior Cup - Hello Adventure!]]'', where he lined up with all the other competitors in front of [[Alder]], [[Cynthia]], [[Caitlin]] and [[Freddy O'Martian]]. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |width=68% |trainer=Shepherd |pkmn=Galvantula |img=Shepherd Galvantula.png |type1=Bug |type2=Electric |epnum=BW090 |epname=Jostling for the Junior Cup! |desc={{p|Galvantula}} is the only Pokémon Shepherd is known to have on hand. It was used in the first round of the Junior Cup but lost to [[Cilan's Pansage]]. None of Galvantula's moves are known.}} ==Pokémon competitions== Shepherd has competed in the following {{cat|Pokémon competitions}}: * [[Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup]] - Top 16 (''[[BW090|Jostling for the Junior Cup!]]'') ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{bug color}}|bordercolor={{electric color light}} |ja=三宅健太 ''[[Kenta Miyake]]'' |en=[[Marc Thompson]] |es_eu=Eduardo del Hoyo |fi=Markus Bäckman}}
